name: Feature Request
description: Suggest an idea or new feature for ENIAD-ASSISTANT
title: '[FEATURE] '
labels: ['enhancement']
assignees: ''

body:
  - type: textarea
    id: feature-description
    attributes:
      label: Is your feature request related to a problem?
      description: A clear description of what the problem is.
    validations:
      required: true
  - type: textarea
    id: proposed-solution
    attributes:
      label: Describe the solution you'd like
      description: A detailed description of what you want to happen.
    validations:
      required: true
